text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy conquered the Japanese 
Derby. Under the watchful eye of Symboli 
Kris S, she became the protagonist of the 
story she had longed for that day.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
She had achieved a historic first— victory 
in the Aoba Sho, followed by victory in 
the Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by the press, Zenno Rob Roy is 
asked about her goal and finally gives her 
answer. —"A hero."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
The next target race is the "Kikuka Sho." 
A grand stage truly fit for a future hero.
